snippet.title: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials - Official Demo Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Demo Trailer for 13Z: The Zodiac Trials, a fast-paced anime action game developed by Mixed Realms. Players will take powerful builds into the heat of battle to take on mythological trials and become the thirteenth Zodiac. 13Z: The Zodiac Trials is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now through June 25 on Steam.
